mission: Build a durable self-documenting Chat Object that can reincarnate into any fresh ChatGPT conversation and orchestrate many disposable one-shot worker chats whose jobs are prepared in advance and whose durable progress/results return without human context transport.
human_goal: The human can cut this chat at any time, open another, select this durable object and continue exactly; the main object can also prepare many short-code worker jobs, keep working while they run, and know from durable state when 0/N, partial or N/N workers have returned.
current_frontier: Implement the executable layer beneath the already-defined product: runtime/compiler support for chat_object/work_item/run/batch state, `Prometeo <launch_code>` run creation/STARTED, derived batch status and fresh-chat reincarnation tests. Then execute/integrate first prepared batch B-CHATOBJ-01.
implemented_this_slice: Defined PRODUCT_BLUEPRINT_V2 with complete product north star and categorized idea index.
Defined CHAT_OBJECT_CONTRACT_V1 and instantiated CHAT_OBJECT.json for this durable working identity.
Created SHARED_GRAPH mapping existing Prometeo capabilities to reuse/extend.
Defined DELEGATED_WORK_PROTOCOL_V1: durable job exists before worker chat, independent runs, STARTED -> RETURN -> DONE, parent integration.
Created WORK_BOARD with first six-job self-building batch B-CHATOBJ-01 and launch codes P-CC-01..06.
Persisted six dispatchable JOB.json files for runtime audit, schema critic, launch resolver, batch compiler, reincarnation tests and historical reuse review.
Updated Home selector so project-prometeo-chat-control resolves to chat-object-prometeo-chat-control-main.
Updated p.txt, stable entry and chat bootstrap so Prometeo reincarnates Chat Objects and `Prometeo <launch_code>` denotes prepared one-shot work.
Replaced mailbox-centric INDEX with current Chat Object / JOB / Run / RETURN architecture.
Updated PACK to the new product target/frontier.
must_preserve: ChatGPT conversation is disposable shell; durable Chat Object is identity/state.
Agent Network v3 independent worker-state + derived network model.
Compiled Work Packets, Execution Packets and durable RETURN/recovery.
Human never transports recoverable long context or worker returns.
Menu numbers and launch codes are aliases only, never durable identity.
Jobs exist durably before worker chats are opened.
Parallel workers never all mutate one shared central status file.
important_discoveries: Inbox/Outbox is not the primary abstraction; durable Chat Object state plus JOB/Run/RETURN is.
Project identity alone is too coarse; a project may contain multiple durable Chat Objects.
The active chat needs more than FOCUS: Design Board, Rules/negative knowledge, Shared Graph and Work Board are first-class.
Worker jobs should be precompiled before a worker chat exists; the short launch message is only an address.
Parent should derive partial/full batch completion from independent run/return state and remain useful while workers execute.
Historical Planner/Compiler, SESSION_RETURN/rehydration, Recovery Sweep and Steward/Merger patterns are precedents to recover/reuse, not redesign blindly.
ChatGPT history can help archaeology but must not be required for correctness.
Prometeo can now use the mechanism to build itself: first six jobs are already prepared.
settled_decisions: Use ChatGPT as frontend/home and native conversation/voice layer.
Fresh/unbound Prometeo renders Home; Home selection resolves to a durable Chat Object when bound.
`Prometeo <launch_code>` is the minimal one-shot worker launch syntax.
Normal worker return path is Chat Object -> JOB -> independent Run -> RETURN -> parent integration.
Directed messages/events are secondary and should be implemented only for gaps that state/returns cannot cover.
Persist distilled operational state, not transcript dumps.
Small corrections remain surgical preserve-first deltas.
Parallel workers may overlap read-only analysis; overlapping candidate writes require explicit reconciliation before promotion.
negative_knowledge: Do not reduce the product to Inbox/Outbox.
Do not use menu numbers or launch codes as durable identity.
Do not treat transcript as database.
Do not launch a worker before its JOB/context/return contract exists durably.
Do not make the human copy long prompts/context/results.
Do not infer worker STARTED/DONE from silence or conversational claims.
Do not make all workers mutate one shared status object.
Do not block the parent merely because workers are active.
Do not globally broadcast worker chatter.
Do not duplicate existing shared capabilities before owner discovery.
Do not let worker candidates/newest commits self-promote to Current/Human Accepted/Served.
Do not continue investing in custom floating-button/audio UI on the critical path.
Do not reconstruct old Prometeo machinery before searching for reusable Planner/Compiler/Return/recovery implementations.
open_questions: Exact runtime/compiler modifications for native chat_object_id/work_item_id/batch/run/return-consumption projections.
Best automatic worker_instance_id/run creation mechanism from a fresh launch-code chat using currently available write transport.
Which existing SESSION_RETURN/rehydration/Planner/Compiler implementation can be reused directly.
Exact derived Work Board format: keep source board declarative and publish separate compiled runtime view vs refresh board itself.
How to record optional ChatGPT conversation source refs when platform metadata is exposed without depending on them.
Facultad and Alumnos still need one-time recovery into their own durable Chat Objects.
next_actions: Finish aligning IDENTITY/runtime metadata to chat_object_id model.
Implement/compile launch-code resolution + independent Worker Run status semantics.
Implement derived batch status from run/RETURN objects.
Run reincarnation tests and actual fresh-chat Home -> Chat Object trial.
Use P-CC-01..P-CC-06 to execute first parallel batch in disposable chats once launch/run persistence path is validated.
Consume/reconcile all batch returns through this Chat Object and update blueprint/focus/rules accordingly.
Test parent conversation erasure and reincarnation with worker batch state intact.
continuation_rule: A future chat must load stable entry, resolve project-prometeo-chat-control -> chat-object-prometeo-chat-control-main, then load CHAT_OBJECT.json + FOCUS + PRODUCT_BLUEPRINT_V2 + WORK_BOARD + SHARED_GRAPH + relevant PACK/runtime state and continue current_frontier. Do not restore the older mailbox-first architecture and do not ask the human to restate this conversation.
